design_rule: One primary_family per failure. Secondary effects belong in contributes_to. If owner preference is clear but taxonomy cannot explain it, diagnostic_status may remain UNRESOLVED.
anti_double_counting_rules: A single observable weakness has exactly one primary_family.
If repetition causes stalled progression, primary_family is REDUNDANCY and stalled progression is recorded in contributes_to.
Use EXPOSITION_LOAD when the listener must hold too much information before it produces value; use SPOKEN_COMPREHENSION when expression itself is hard to decode in one pass.
Macro failures without one causal sentence use UNIT_GLOBAL with anchor spans rather than inventing a single culprit span.
Truth failures are not Product defect families; they belong to the independent Truth lane.

legacy_mapping_notes.continue: Diagnostic consequences may map to NARRATIVE_FUNCTION or VOICE_STANCE; no longer a required primary score.
legacy_mapping_notes.connections: Primarily represented by NARRATIVE_FUNCTION.UNMOTIVATED_TRANSITION or LOST_ORIENTATION.
legacy_mapping_notes.spoken_comprehension: Moved to SPOKEN_COMPREHENSION plus the independent spoken-evidence lane.
legacy_mapping_notes.essay_tendency: Not a score. Typically resolves to VOICE_STANCE and/or EXPOSITION_LOAD, otherwise UNRESOLVED.
